items.headline: Vidarbha wins maiden Vijay Hazare Trophy title
items.detail: Vidarbha won its first Vijay Hazare Trophy, beating Saurashtra by 38 runs in the final at Bengaluru. Atharva Taide scored 128 and Aman Mokhade finished as Player of the Tournament with 814 runs.
examFacts: Vijay Hazare Trophy 2025-26 winner: Vidarbha (maiden title)
Player of the Tournament: Aman Mokhade (814 runs)

items.headline: Saina Nehwal announces retirement
items.detail: Badminton star Saina Nehwal announced her retirement, ending a 21-year career. She won India's first Olympic badminton medal, a bronze at London 2012, and became the first Indian woman world No. 1 in 2015.
examFacts: First Indian woman badminton world No. 1 (2015)

items.headline: Bulgaria becomes 21st member of the Eurozone
items.detail: Bulgaria adopted the euro on January 1, 2026, replacing its currency, the lev, at a fixed rate of 1 euro = 1.95583 lev. It became the 21st member of the Eurozone.
examFacts: Bulgaria joined the Eurozone: 1 January 2026 (21st member)

items.headline: President launches SOAR skilling programme
items.detail: President Droupadi Murmu launched the Skilling for AI Readiness (SOAR) programme on January 1, 2026, along with the #SkillTheNation Challenge. The programme of the Ministry of Skill Development aims to prepare young Indians for an AI-driven economy.
examFacts: SOAR: Skilling for AI Readiness (Ministry of Skill Development)
Launched by President Droupadi Murmu on 1 January 2026

items.headline: Piprahwa relics of Buddha displayed after 127 years
items.detail: Prime Minister Modi inaugurated the Grand International Exposition 'The Light and the Lotus: Relics of the Awakened One' in New Delhi on January 3, 2026. The sacred Piprahwa relics, discovered in 1898, were repatriated from Hong Kong and displayed together after 127 years with more than 80 artefacts.
examFacts: Piprahwa Buddha relics exposition: 'The Light and the Lotus'
Relics discovered in 1898; displayed together after 127 years

items.headline: Former IOA chief Suresh Kalmadi dies at 81
items.detail: Suresh Kalmadi, former President of the Indian Olympic Association from 1996 to 2012 and chairman of the 2010 Commonwealth Games organising committee, died in Pune at 81. He also served as Minister of State for Railways.
examFacts: He chaired the organising committee of the 2010 Delhi Commonwealth Games

items.headline: Noted ecologist Madhav Gadgil passes away
items.detail: Eminent ecologist Madhav Gadgil died at the age of 83 in January 2026. He was widely known for his work on ecology and the Western Ghats.

items.headline: Pravasi Bharatiya Divas marks Gandhi's return
items.detail: Pravasi Bharatiya Divas was observed on January 9, marking Mahatma Gandhi's return to India from South Africa in 1915. The convention is held biennially since 2015, and the 19th edition will be hosted in 2027.
examFacts: Marks Gandhi's return to India on 9 January 1915

items.headline: National Youth Day marks Vivekananda's 163rd birth anniversary
items.detail: National Youth Day was observed on January 12, 2026, the 163rd birth anniversary of Swami Vivekananda. It coincided with the 2nd Viksit Bharat Young Leaders' Dialogue at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi.
examFacts: National Youth Day: 12 January (Swami Vivekananda's birthday)

items.headline: PSLV-C62 mission fails after third stage anomaly
items.detail: The PSLV-C62 mission suffered an anomaly after ignition of its third stage on January 12, 2026, the second straight failure of the rocket. It was the 64th PSLV flight, carrying DRDO's EOS-N1 satellite and 15 co-passengers.
examFacts: PSLV-C62 failed after a third-stage anomaly (January 2026)

items.headline: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz visits India
items.detail: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz paid his first official visit to India on January 12-13, 2026, as Chief Guest of the International Kite Festival in Ahmedabad. The two countries signed 19 MoUs and marked 25 years of their Strategic Partnership.
examFacts: Friedrich Merz: first German Chancellor visit focused on India ties
19 MoUs signed; 25 years of India-Germany Strategic Partnership

items.headline: India's non-fossil power capacity crosses 266 GW
items.detail: MNRE data showed India's non-fossil fuel power capacity reached 266.78 GW in 2025, a rise of 22.6% in one year. Solar led with 131.81 GW, followed by wind at 54.51 GW, supporting the 500 GW clean energy target for 2030.

items.headline: Singapore tops Henley Passport Index 2026; India 80th
items.detail: The Henley Passport Index 2026, released on January 13, ranked Singapore first with visa-free access to 192 destinations. India climbed five places to 80th, with visa-free access to 55 destinations.
examFacts: Henley Passport Index 2026 topper: Singapore (192 destinations)

items.headline: Armed Forces Veterans' Day observed for 10th time
items.detail: The 10th Armed Forces Veterans' Day was observed on January 14, 2026. The day marks the retirement of Field Marshal K. M. Cariappa, the first Indian Commander-in-Chief of the Army, in 1953.
examFacts: Honours Field Marshal K. M. Cariappa (retired 1953)

items.headline: Bhairav drone force debuts at 78th Army Day parade
items.detail: The 78th Army Day parade was held in Jaipur, the first time outside a military cantonment. The Indian Army's new 'Bhairav' drone warfare force, with 15 battalions raised, made its debut at the parade.
examFacts: 78th Army Day parade: Jaipur (first outside a cantonment)
Bhairav force: Army's drone warfare force with 15 battalions

items.headline: India begins BRICS chairship for 2026
items.detail: India launched its BRICS chairship for 2026, its fourth tenure as chair, coinciding with the group's 20th anniversary. The theme is 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability', with a lotus-inspired logo.
examFacts: Theme: Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability

items.headline: Maharashtra tops Export Preparedness Index 2024
items.detail: NITI Aayog released the 4th Export Preparedness Index, in which Maharashtra topped the large states with a score of 68.01, followed by Tamil Nadu and Gujarat. Uttarakhand led among smaller states.
examFacts: Export Preparedness Index 2024 topper (large states): Maharashtra

items.headline: World Bank projects India's growth at 7.2% for FY26
items.detail: The World Bank's Global Economic Prospects report raised India's growth forecast for FY 2025-26 to 7.2%, keeping India the fastest-growing major economy. Growth is expected at 6.5% in FY27.
examFacts: World Bank FY26 growth forecast for India: 7.2%

items.headline: Aaryan Varshney becomes India's 92nd chess Grandmaster
items.detail: Delhi's 21-year-old Aaryan Varshney became India's 92nd Grandmaster by securing his final norm at the Andranik Margaryan Memorial tournament in Armenia. He is the eighth GM from Delhi.
examFacts: Norm earned at the Andranik Margaryan Memorial, Armenia

items.headline: Foundation laid for world's largest green hydrogen plant
items.detail: The foundation for the world's largest green hydrogen and ammonia plant was laid at Kakinada, Andhra Pradesh. AM Green plans a USD 10 billion (about Rs 84,000 crore) investment with a capacity of 1.5 MTPA of green ammonia in phases by 2030.
examFacts: World's largest green hydrogen/ammonia plant: Kakinada (Andhra Pradesh)

items.headline: RBI notifies new Integrated Ombudsman Scheme
items.detail: The RBI announced the revised Integrated Ombudsman Scheme 2026, effective July 1, 2026. Compensation for consequential loss rises to Rs 30 lakh and for time and harassment to Rs 3 lakh, with no cap on the dispute amount.
examFacts: Compensation for consequential loss: up to Rs 30 lakh

items.headline: Nitin Nabin elected BJP National President
items.detail: Nitin Nabin was elected National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party on January 19, 2026.

items.headline: UAE President visits India; trade target raised
items.detail: UAE President Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan visited India on January 19, 2026, his third visit as President. Both countries agreed to expand the CEPA trade pact with a target of over USD 200 billion in trade by 2032, and announced cooperation in supercomputing and small modular nuclear reactors.
examFacts: India-UAE trade target: over USD 200 billion by 2032
UAE President: Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan

items.headline: New chiefs appointed for NIA, BSF and ITBP
items.detail: The government appointed Rakesh Aggarwal as Director General of the NIA, Praveen Kumar as DG of the BSF and Shatrujeet Singh Kapoor as DG of the ITBP. Former IPS officer Praveen Vashista was appointed Vigilance Commissioner in the CVC.

items.headline: Second nationwide river dolphin survey launched
items.detail: The Environment Ministry launched the second nationwide survey of river dolphins from Bijnor in Uttar Pradesh under Project Dolphin. The first survey of 2021-23 had counted about 6,327 riverine dolphins.
examFacts: First nationwide dolphin count: about 6,327 riverine dolphins (2021-23)

items.headline: ECI hosts first IICDEM; launches ECINET
items.detail: The Election Commission hosted the first India International Conference on Democracy and Election Management at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, concluding with the Delhi Declaration 2026. It launched ECINET, a single platform for election services, available in English and 22 scheduled languages.
examFacts: ECI's digital platform: ECINET (English + 22 scheduled languages)
IICDEM concluded with the Delhi Declaration 2026

items.headline: Astronaut Sunita Williams retires from NASA
items.detail: Indian-origin NASA astronaut Sunita Williams retired after 27 years of service. She spent 608 days in space and performed nine spacewalks totalling over 62 hours, a record for women astronauts.
examFacts: Her 9 spacewalks (62 hours 6 minutes) set a record for women

items.headline: Atal Pension Yojana extended till 2030-31
items.detail: The Union Cabinet approved the continuation of the Atal Pension Yojana until FY 2030-31. Launched in May 2015 and run by PFRDA, the scheme guarantees pensions of Rs 1,000 to Rs 5,000 a month and has over 8.66 crore subscribers.
examFacts: Atal Pension Yojana extended till: FY 2030-31

items.headline: WEF Global Risks Report flags geoeconomic confrontation
items.detail: The World Economic Forum's Global Risks Report 2026 named geoeconomic confrontation the top risk over the next two years and extreme weather the most severe over ten years. Cyber insecurity was flagged as India's principal risk.
examFacts: Top two-year global risk (2026): geoeconomic confrontation

items.headline: CDS releases Military Quantum Mission framework
items.detail: Chief of Defence Staff General Anil Chauhan released the policy framework for the Military Quantum Mission, aligned with the National Quantum Mission. It covers four pillars: quantum communication, computing, sensing and metrology, and materials and devices.
examFacts: Military Quantum Mission framework released by: CDS Gen Anil Chauhan
Four pillars: communication, computing, sensing/metrology, materials

items.headline: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana completes 11 years
items.detail: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana, launched on January 22, 2015 under Beti Bachao Beti Padhao, completed 11 years. It has over 4.53 crore accounts with deposits above Rs 3.33 lakh crore and pays 8.2% interest.
examFacts: Accounts: over 4.53 crore, deposits above Rs 3.33 lakh crore

items.headline: Parakram Diwas marks Netaji's 129th birth anniversary
items.detail: Parakram Diwas was observed on January 23, 2026, the 129th birth anniversary of Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose. The day has been celebrated since 2021, and the 2026 event was held at Sri Vijaya Puram in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands.
examFacts: Parakram Diwas: 23 January (Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose's birthday)

items.headline: Subhash Chandra Bose Aapda Prabandhan Puraskar announced
items.detail: The 2026 Subhash Chandra Bose Aapda Prabandhan Puraskar for disaster management was announced: the Sikkim State Disaster Management Authority in the institutional category and Lt Col Seeta Ashok Shelke of the Indian Army in the individual category.
examFacts: Individual winner: Lt Col Seeta Ashok Shelke

items.headline: National Girl Child Day observed
items.detail: National Girl Child Day was observed on January 24, the 19th edition since the day was instituted by the Women and Child Development Ministry in 2008. It coincided with the 11th anniversary of the Beti Bachao Beti Padhao scheme.

items.headline: Padma Awards 2026 announced with 131 honours
items.detail: The Padma Awards 2026 were announced on the eve of Republic Day: 5 Padma Vibhushan, 13 Padma Bhushan and 113 Padma Shri, including 19 women and 16 posthumous awards. Cricketers Rohit Sharma and Harmanpreet Kaur received the Padma Shri, and Maharashtra had the most awardees at 15.
examFacts: Padma Awards 2026: 131 total (5 PV, 13 PB, 113 PS)
Rohit Sharma and Harmanpreet Kaur: Padma Shri
Highest awards from one state: Maharashtra (15)

items.headline: National Voters' Day celebrated with 'My India, My Vote' theme
items.detail: The 16th National Voters' Day was observed on January 25, 2026, with the theme 'My India, My Vote', marking 76 years of the Election Commission of India founded on January 25, 1950.

items.headline: 77th Republic Day showcases EU partnership
items.detail: India celebrated its 77th Republic Day with the theme '150 Years of Vande Mataram'. For the first time, the European Council President Antonio Costa and European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen were jointly the Chief Guests. DRDO displayed its first Long Range Anti-Ship Hypersonic Missile.
examFacts: 77th Republic Day theme: '150 Years of Vande Mataram'
First time both EU leaders were Republic Day Chief Guests

items.headline: Gallantry awards announced for Republic Day 2026
items.detail: President Murmu approved 70 gallantry awards, with the Ashoka Chakra going to Group Captain Shubhanshu Shukla, the first Indian on the International Space Station. Navy women officers Lt Cdr Dilna K and Lt Cdr Roopa A received the Shaurya Chakra.
examFacts: Ashoka Chakra 2026: Group Captain Shubhanshu Shukla
First Indian on the ISS: Shubhanshu Shukla (Axiom-4)

items.headline: India and EU conclude free trade agreement talks
items.detail: At the 16th India-EU Summit in New Delhi, India and the European Union concluded negotiations for a long-awaited Free Trade Agreement. Both sides also endorsed the '2030 Joint India-EU Comprehensive Strategic Agenda', making the EU India's 22nd FTA partner.

items.headline: India Energy Week 2026 held in Goa
items.detail: India Energy Week 2026, the government's flagship energy event, was held in Goa from January 27 to 30. Reliance and ONGC signed a resource-sharing agreement for KG Basin and Andaman offshore blocks on the sidelines.
examFacts: RIL-ONGC pact covers: KG Basin and Andaman blocks

items.headline: Wings India 2026 aviation show held at Hyderabad
items.detail: Wings India 2026, Asia's largest civil aviation event, was held from January 28 to 31 at Begumpet Airport, Hyderabad. Union Civil Aviation Minister Ram Mohan Naidu inaugurated it, and Air India ordered 30 more Boeing narrowbody jets, taking its Boeing orders to 250.

items.headline: Maharashtra Deputy CM Ajit Pawar dies in plane crash
items.detail: Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister and NCP chief Ajit Pawar died on January 28, 2026, when his Learjet 45 crashed at Baramati airport in Pune district. He was 66 and had served as Deputy Chief Minister six times.
examFacts: Ajit Pawar died in a Learjet 45 crash at Baramati (28 January 2026)
He was Maharashtra Deputy CM six times

items.headline: India's Ramsar sites rise to 98
items.detail: India added two new Ramsar wetlands of international importance, taking its count to 98: Patna Bird Sanctuary in Uttar Pradesh, the 97th site, and Chhari-Dhand in Gujarat's Kutch, the 98th. Tamil Nadu has the most Ramsar sites among states.
examFacts: India's 97th Ramsar site: Patna Bird Sanctuary (Uttar Pradesh)
State with most Ramsar sites: Tamil Nadu

items.headline: Sunetra Pawar becomes Maharashtra's first woman Deputy CM
items.detail: Sunetra Pawar was sworn in as Deputy Chief Minister of Maharashtra on January 31, 2026, the first woman to hold the post. Governor Acharya Devvrat administered the oath after the death of Ajit Pawar.
examFacts: Maharashtra's first woman Deputy CM: Sunetra Pawar
Oath administered by Governor Acharya Devvrat

quiz.q: Who were the Chief Guests at India's 77th Republic Day parade in 2026?
options: The Presidents of France and Russia
The EU Council President and EU Commission President
The Prime Ministers of Japan and Australia
The King of Bhutan and the President of Singapore
quiz.solution: European Council President Antonio Costa and European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen were jointly the Chief Guests, the first time both EU leaders were invited.

quiz.q: How many Padma Awards were announced in 2026?
quiz.solution: The Padma Awards 2026 list had 131 awards: 5 Padma Vibhushan, 13 Padma Bhushan and 113 Padma Shri.

quiz.q: Who received the Ashoka Chakra on Republic Day 2026?
quiz.solution: Group Captain Shubhanshu Shukla, the first Indian on the International Space Station, was awarded the Ashoka Chakra.

quiz.q: After the India-EU Free Trade Agreement, the EU becomes India's which numbered FTA partner?
quiz.solution: With FTA talks concluded in January 2026, the EU became India's 22nd free trade agreement partner.

quiz.q: What was the theme of India's BRICS chairship for 2026?
options: Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability
quiz.solution: India's fourth BRICS chairship used the theme 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability' in the group's 20th anniversary year.

quiz.q: Who was elected the National President of the BJP in January 2026?
quiz.solution: Nitin Nabin was elected BJP National President on January 19, 2026.

quiz.q: Who became the first woman Deputy Chief Minister of Maharashtra?
quiz.solution: Sunetra Pawar was sworn in as Deputy CM on January 31, 2026, after Ajit Pawar's death.

quiz.q: Where was Wings India 2026, Asia's largest civil aviation event, held?
quiz.solution: Wings India 2026 was held at Begumpet Airport, Hyderabad, from January 28 to 31.

quiz.q: Chhari-Dhand, designated as India's 98th Ramsar site in January 2026, is located in which state?
quiz.solution: Chhari-Dhand is in Gujarat's Kutch district; the 97th site, Patna Bird Sanctuary, is in Uttar Pradesh.

quiz.q: Under the RBI Integrated Ombudsman Scheme 2026, the maximum compensation for consequential loss is raised to:
quiz.solution: RB-IOS 2026, effective July 1, 2026, raises compensation for consequential loss to Rs 30 lakh.

items.headline: Union Budget 2026-27 presented with Rs 53.47 lakh crore outlay
items.detail: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman presented the Union Budget 2026-27 in Parliament on February 1, 2026. Total expenditure was estimated at Rs 53.47 lakh crore, about 7.7% higher than the previous year's revised estimate. The budget raised the electronics component scheme outlay to Rs 40,000 crore and announced the Biopharma SHAKTI initiative.
examFacts: Budget 2026-27 total expenditure: Rs 53.47 lakh crore

items.headline: 16th Finance Commission report recommends 41% devolution
items.detail: The report of the 16th Finance Commission was tabled in Parliament along with the Union Budget 2026-27. It recommended that 41% of the central taxes be shared with the states for 2026-31.

items.headline: Indian Coast Guard celebrates 50th Raising Day
items.detail: The Indian Coast Guard observed its 50th Raising Day on February 1, 2026. It was formed on February 1, 1977 under the Coast Guard Act, 1978, and protects India's maritime interests.
examFacts: Coast Guard works under the Ministry of Defence

items.headline: Dalai Lama wins first Grammy at 68th Grammy Awards
items.detail: At the 68th Grammy Awards in Los Angeles, the Dalai Lama won his first Grammy for Best Audio Book for 'Meditations'. Bad Bunny became the first artist to win Album of the Year with a Spanish-language album, while 'Luther' by Kendrick Lamar and SZA won Record of the Year.
examFacts: Dalai Lama won his first Grammy (Best Audio Book)
First Spanish-language Album of the Year: Bad Bunny

items.headline: Alcaraz and Rybakina win Australian Open 2026
items.detail: Carlos Alcaraz of Spain beat Novak Djokovic to win the Australian Open men's title, becoming the youngest man of the Open Era to complete a career Grand Slam. Kazakhstan's Elena Rybakina won the women's title, beating Aryna Sabalenka, the first Kazakh woman to do so.
examFacts: Australian Open 2026 men's champion: Carlos Alcaraz
Alcaraz: youngest man to complete career Grand Slam (Open Era)

items.headline: Yumnam Khemchand sworn in as Manipur Chief Minister
items.detail: BJP leader Yumnam Khemchand was sworn in as Manipur's Chief Minister on February 4, 2026, ending President's Rule imposed in February 2025. Nemcha Kipgen became the state's first woman Deputy Chief Minister.
examFacts: Manipur's first woman Deputy CM: Nemcha Kipgen

items.headline: RBI keeps repo rate unchanged at 5.25%
items.detail: The RBI's Monetary Policy Committee, chaired by Governor Sanjay Malhotra, kept the repo rate unchanged at 5.25% in its review for FY 2025-26. The stance stayed 'neutral', with SDF at 5.00% and MSF and Bank Rate at 5.50%.

items.headline: India wins sixth U-19 Cricket World Cup
items.detail: India beat England by 100 runs in the final at Harare to win the ICC U-19 Men's Cricket World Cup for the sixth time. Vaibhav Suryavanshi hit 175 off 80 balls, the highest score in a U-19 final, and was named Player of the Tournament.
examFacts: U-19 World Cup 2026: India's 6th title (beat England by 100 runs)
Vaibhav Suryavanshi scored 175 off 80 balls in the final

items.headline: Frontier Nagaland Territorial Authority agreement signed
items.detail: The Centre, Nagaland government and the Eastern Nagaland People's Organisation signed a tripartite agreement to create the Frontier Nagaland Territorial Authority covering six districts, with 46 subjects devolved to it.
examFacts: Frontier Nagaland Territorial Authority covers: 6 districts

items.headline: India and USA agree framework for interim trade pact
items.detail: India and the United States announced a Framework for an Interim Trade Agreement. India will cut tariffs on several industrial and farm goods, while the US keeps an 18% reciprocal tariff on some Indian goods and India will buy USD 500 billion of American products over five years.
examFacts: US reciprocal tariff under the deal: 18%
India to buy USD 500 billion of US goods over 5 years

items.headline: India's first Quantum Valley foundation laid at Amaravati
items.detail: The foundation stone for India's first Quantum Valley was laid at Amaravati, Andhra Pradesh, with support from the National Quantum Mission. Partners include IBM, TCS, L&T, C-DOT and C-DAC, and it will host India's first 133-qubit quantum computer centre.
examFacts: India's first Quantum Valley: Amaravati (Andhra Pradesh)

items.headline: Japan's ruling LDP wins big under Sanae Takaichi
items.detail: In Japan's general election, the Liberal Democratic Party led by Sanae Takaichi, Japan's first woman Prime Minister, won a record 316 of 465 lower house seats. Her coalition with the Japan Innovation Party took the total to 352.
examFacts: Japan's first woman PM: Sanae Takaichi

items.headline: India ranks 45th on Network Readiness Index 2025
items.detail: In the Network Readiness Index 2025, the USA ranked first for the fourth straight year and India climbed four places to 45th among 127 economies, second among lower-middle-income countries after Vietnam.

items.headline: Rajasthan is India's largest wool producer
items.detail: Official data showed Rajasthan produces about 47.5% of India's wool, the highest among states, followed by Jammu and Kashmir and Karnataka. India has about 77.4 million sheep, the second highest in the world.

items.headline: Mons Mouton-4 chosen as Chandrayaan-4 landing site
items.detail: ISRO selected the Mons Mouton-4 region near the Moon's south pole as the landing site for Chandrayaan-4, India's first lunar sample-return mission. The site was studied using Chandrayaan-2 images.
examFacts: Chandrayaan-4 mission type: lunar sample return

items.headline: India improves to 91st in Corruption Perceptions Index
items.detail: Transparency International's Corruption Perceptions Index 2025 ranked India 91st of 180 countries with a score of 39, an improvement from 96th the previous year. Denmark topped the list for the eighth straight year.
examFacts: CPI is released by Transparency International

items.headline: Quarterly PLFS shows unemployment at 4.8%
items.detail: The NSO's quarterly PLFS bulletin put India's unemployment rate at 4.8% for October-December 2025, a three-quarter low. Rural unemployment fell to 4% while urban unemployment was 6.7%.

items.headline: Defence Acquisition Council clears Rs 3.25 lakh crore Rafale deal
items.detail: The DAC, chaired by Rajnath Singh, approved the purchase of 114 Rafale fighter jets from France for about Rs 3.25 lakh crore, along with six more P-8I aircraft for the Navy. Of the Rafales, 18 will come ready-built and 96 will be made in India.
examFacts: DAC-approved Rafale deal: 114 jets, about Rs 3.25 lakh crore
96 of the 114 Rafales will be Made in India

items.headline: Tarique Rahman sworn in as Bangladesh's 11th Prime Minister
items.detail: BNP chief Tarique Rahman was sworn in as Bangladesh's 11th Prime Minister, the first head of government after the July Revolution. His BNP-led alliance won 212 of 299 seats, and he succeeded interim Chief Adviser Muhammad Yunus.
examFacts: He succeeded interim chief adviser Muhammad Yunus

items.headline: Vibrant Villages Programme-II launched from Assam
items.detail: Home Minister Amit Shah launched Vibrant Villages Programme-II at Nathanpur in Assam. The scheme has an outlay of Rs 6,839 crore till FY29 and covers 1,954 border villages across 15 states and two Union Territories.
examFacts: VVP-II outlay: Rs 6,839 crore till FY29

items.headline: Cabinet clears Rs 1 lakh crore Urban Challenge Fund
items.detail: The Union Cabinet approved a Rs 1 lakh crore Urban Challenge Fund for FY26-FY31 and a Rs 10,000 crore Startup India Fund of Funds 2.0. The Centre will fund 25% under the urban fund, with at least half the project cost from market sources.
examFacts: Urban Challenge Fund outlay: Rs 1 lakh crore
Startup India Fund of Funds 2.0: Rs 10,000 crore

items.headline: Smriti Mandhana named BBC Indian Sportswoman of the Year
items.detail: Smriti Mandhana won the BBC Indian Sportswoman of the Year award for her role in India's 2025 Women's ODI World Cup win and RCB's WPL title. Chess player Divya Deshmukh won the Emerging Player award and shooter Anjali Bhagwat got the Lifetime Achievement honour.
examFacts: BBC Indian Sportswoman of the Year 2025: Smriti Mandhana

items.headline: India unveils first AI Governance Framework
items.detail: The government released India's first comprehensive AI Governance Framework under the IndiaAI Mission. It rests on seven guiding principles, called Sutras, including 'People First' and 'Fairness and Equity'.
examFacts: Framework released under the IndiaAI Mission

items.headline: PM RAHAT scheme for cashless accident treatment
items.detail: The government approved the PM RAHAT scheme, giving cashless treatment of up to Rs 1.5 lakh per road accident victim for seven days. It is linked to the 112 emergency helpline.
examFacts: PM RAHAT scheme covers: Rs 1.5 lakh cashless treatment for 7 days
PM RAHAT deals with road accident victims

items.headline: India's largest lithium battery gigafactory planned in Andhra Pradesh
items.detail: Waaree Energies announced a Rs 8,175 crore lithium-ion battery gigafactory at Rambilli in Anakapalli district, Andhra Pradesh. With about 16 GWh capacity, it will be India's largest.
examFacts: Waaree gigafactory location: Rambilli, Andhra Pradesh

items.headline: India hosts 2nd India-AI Impact Summit
items.detail: The second India-AI Impact Summit was held on February 16-20, 2026 at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, the first such global AI summit in the Global South. Prime Minister Modi unveiled the MANAV framework, a New Delhi Declaration on AI Impact was endorsed by 91 countries and organisations, and Geneva will host the 2027 edition.
examFacts: 2nd India-AI Impact Summit: New Delhi, February 2026
New Delhi Declaration endorsed by 91 countries

items.headline: Macron visits India; H-125 helicopter line opened
items.detail: French President Emmanuel Macron attended the AI Impact Summit on his fourth India visit. The two countries inaugurated an H-125 helicopter assembly line in Karnataka and declared 2026 the India-France Year of Innovation.
examFacts: H-125 helicopter assembly line state: Karnataka

items.headline: Shashi Tharoor's book on Sree Narayana Guru released
items.detail: Vice President C.P. Radhakrishnan released 'The Sage who Reimagined Hinduism: The Life, Lessons and Legacy of Sree Narayana Guru' by Shashi Tharoor. Sree Narayana Guru was a social reformer from Kerala.
examFacts: Book on Sree Narayana Guru authored by: Shashi Tharoor

items.headline: Norway tops Milano-Cortina Winter Olympics
items.detail: Norway topped the Milano-Cortina 2026 Winter Olympics with 18 gold medals and 41 in total. India was represented by skier Arif Mohammad Khan, who recorded India's best men's slalom finish. It was the first Winter Games hosted by two cities.
examFacts: India's representative: Arif Mohammad Khan (alpine skiing)

items.headline: Bihar to get greenfield international airport at Sonpur
items.detail: The Bihar Cabinet approved a greenfield international airport at Sonpur in Saran district, to be India's 24th greenfield airport. The state sanctioned Rs 1,302 crore for land and completion is targeted by 2030.
examFacts: Bihar's greenfield airport site: Sonpur (Saran district)

items.headline: Former Union Minister Mukul Roy dies at 71
items.detail: Mukul Roy, a founding member of the Trinamool Congress and former Union Railway Minister, died in Kolkata at 71. He served as the 32nd Railway Minister in 2012.
examFacts: Mukul Roy: former Union Railway Minister (2012), TMC founder-member

items.headline: Sachin Tendulkar named UN Global Road Safety Champion
items.detail: Sachin Tendulkar was named a UN Global Road Safety Champion under a campaign with JCDecaux, supporting a project on sustainable financing for road safety in India with WHO, UNICEF and UNESCAP.
examFacts: UN Global Road Safety Champion: Sachin Tendulkar

items.headline: Union Cabinet approves renaming Kerala as Keralam
items.detail: The Union Cabinet approved renaming the state of Kerala as 'Keralam', following Assembly resolutions. A constitutional amendment bill under Article 3 is required to change the name in the First Schedule.
examFacts: Kerala renamed as: Keralam (Cabinet approval, February 2026)
Renaming a state needs a Bill under Article 3

items.headline: PRAHAAR: India's first counter-terrorism policy released
items.detail: The Home Ministry released 'PRAHAAR', India's first national counter-terrorism policy and strategy, built on seven pillars covering prevention, response, human rights and resilience.

items.headline: CBDC-based digital food currency piloted in Puducherry
items.detail: The government launched a CBDC-based Digital Food Currency pilot in Puducherry for direct benefit transfer under the PMGKAY food security programme. Beneficiaries get programmable digital rupee tokens that can be redeemed at Fair Price Shops.
examFacts: CBDC food currency pilot state/UT: Puducherry

items.headline: E20 petrol nationwide from April 2026
items.detail: The Petroleum Ministry mandated that from April 1, 2026 all petrol in the country will have up to 20% ethanol blending and a minimum octane number of 95. India's ethanol blending programme began in 2003.
examFacts: E20 means: up to 20% ethanol in petrol

items.headline: MILAN 2026 naval exercise held at Visakhapatnam
items.detail: The Indian Navy hosted the 13th MILAN exercise at Visakhapatnam on the theme 'Camaraderie, Cooperation, Collaboration', along with the International Fleet Review reviewed by President Murmu. India also took over the chairmanship of the Indian Ocean Naval Symposium for 2026-28.
examFacts: International Fleet Review 2026 presided by: President Murmu

quiz.q: Who won the men's singles title at the Australian Open 2026?
quiz.solution: Carlos Alcaraz beat Novak Djokovic in the final, becoming the youngest man of the Open Era to complete a career Grand Slam.

quiz.q: India won the ICC U-19 Men's Cricket World Cup 2026 by beating which team in the final?
quiz.solution: India beat England by 100 runs at Harare to lift a record sixth U-19 World Cup title.

quiz.q: What is India's repo rate after the RBI Monetary Policy review of February 2026?
quiz.solution: The MPC kept the repo rate unchanged at 5.25% with a neutral stance.

quiz.q: What share of central taxes did the 16th Finance Commission recommend devolving to states for 2026-31?
quiz.solution: The 16th Finance Commission report, tabled with Budget 2026-27, recommended 41% tax devolution for 2026-31.

quiz.q: Which city hosted the 2nd India-AI Impact Summit in February 2026?
quiz.solution: The summit was held on February 16-20, 2026 at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, with the New Delhi Declaration endorsed by 91 countries.

quiz.q: Who was sworn in as the 11th Prime Minister of Bangladesh in February 2026?
quiz.solution: BNP chief Tarique Rahman succeeded interim Chief Adviser Muhammad Yunus after his alliance won 212 of 299 seats.

quiz.q: The Union Cabinet approved renaming which state as 'Keralam'?
quiz.solution: The Cabinet approved renaming Kerala as Keralam, following state Assembly resolutions, under Article 3 of the Constitution.

quiz.q: The Defence Acquisition Council approved about Rs 3.25 lakh crore in February 2026 for buying how many Rafale jets?
quiz.solution: The DAC cleared 114 Rafale jets from France; 18 will be flyaway and 96 made in India.

quiz.q: Who became Manipur's first woman Deputy Chief Minister in February 2026?
quiz.solution: Nemcha Kipgen took oath as Deputy CM when Yumnam Khemchand became Chief Minister, ending President's Rule.

quiz.q: Which lunar region has ISRO chosen as the Chandrayaan-4 landing site?
quiz.solution: Mons Mouton-4 near the lunar south pole was selected for India's first lunar sample-return mission.

items.headline: EPF interest rate kept at 8.25% for FY26
items.detail: The Central Board of Trustees of EPFO, chaired by Labour Minister Mansukh Mandaviya, retained the EPF interest rate at 8.25% for 2025-26. The board also notified new EPF, EPS and EDLI Schemes 2026.
examFacts: EPFO is headed by the Union Labour Minister

items.headline: MoD signs Rs 5,083 crore deals for helicopters and missiles
items.detail: The Defence Ministry signed contracts worth Rs 5,083 crore: Rs 2,901 crore with HAL for six Advanced Light Helicopters Mk-III for the Coast Guard, and Rs 2,182 crore with Russia's Rosoboronexport for VL-Shtil surface-to-air missiles for the Navy.
examFacts: HAL to build 6 ALH Mk-III (Maritime Role) for Coast Guard
VL-Shtil missiles: bought from Russia for the Navy

items.headline: 11th Raisina Dialogue held in New Delhi
items.detail: The 11th Raisina Dialogue was held on March 5-7, 2026 in New Delhi on the theme 'Samskara - Assertion, Accommodation, Advancement'. Finland's President Alexander Stubb was the Chief Guest, and India-Finland ties were raised to a Strategic Partnership.
examFacts: Chief Guest 2026: Finland President Alexander Stubb

items.headline: Digital census tools and mascots Pragati, Vikas launched
items.detail: Home Minister Amit Shah launched four digital tools for Census 2027, India's first fully digital census, and unveiled mascots 'Pragati' and 'Vikas'. The tools were developed by C-DAC and include a self-enumeration portal.
examFacts: Census 2027 will be India's first fully digital census
Digital census tools developed by C-DAC

items.headline: New Governors and LGs appointed for nine states and UTs
items.detail: President Murmu appointed nine Governors and Lieutenant Governors. Lt Gen Syed Ata Hasnain became Governor of Bihar, Taranjit Singh Sandhu became LG of Delhi, Vinai Kumar Saxena moved to Ladakh, Kavinder Gupta became Governor of Himachal Pradesh and R.N. Ravi moved to West Bengal.
examFacts: Bihar Governor: Lt Gen Syed Ata Hasnain

items.headline: India wins Men's T20 World Cup, defends title
items.detail: India beat New Zealand by 96 runs in the final at the Narendra Modi Stadium, Ahmedabad on March 8, 2026 to win the ICC Men's T20 World Cup. It was India's third title after 2007 and 2024, making India the first team to defend the trophy. The 20-team event was co-hosted with Sri Lanka.
examFacts: T20 World Cup 2026 final: India beat New Zealand by 96 runs
India's T20 World Cup titles: 2007, 2024, 2026 (first to defend)
T20 WC 2026 co-hosts: India and Sri Lanka

items.headline: International Women's Day 2026 observed
items.detail: International Women's Day was observed on March 8 with the United Nations theme 'Rights. Justice. Action. For ALL Women and Girls'. The UN first marked the day in 1975 and the UNGA proclaimed it in 1977.

items.headline: RBI caps bank dividends at 75% of profit under new norms
items.detail: The RBI issued new dividend directions for banks for FY27, replacing the 2025 framework. Dividend payout is capped at 75% of profit after tax and linked to the CET-1 capital ratio; banks with CET-1 of 8% or below cannot pay dividends.
examFacts: Bank dividend cap: 75% of profit after tax
Dividend eligibility now linked to CET-1 ratio

items.headline: India is world's second largest arms importer: SIPRI
items.detail: SIPRI's report on international arms transfers showed India remained the world's second largest arms importer in 2021-25 with an 8.2% share, after Ukraine (9.7%). France and Russia were the top suppliers to India.

items.headline: FATF adds Kuwait and Papua New Guinea to grey list
items.detail: The FATF placed Kuwait and Papua New Guinea on its grey list, taking the total to 22 countries. The decision was taken at the FATF Plenary held in Mexico City.
examFacts: FATF grey list countries after March 2026: 22

items.headline: Jal Jeevan Mission extended till 2028 with Rs 8.69 lakh crore
items.detail: The Union Cabinet extended the Jal Jeevan Mission until 2028 with a total outlay of Rs 8.69 lakh crore, raising central assistance by an extra Rs 1.51 lakh crore. The focus now shifts to sustainable tap water service delivery.
examFacts: JJM new total outlay: Rs 8.69 lakh crore

items.headline: One Battle After Another wins Best Picture at 98th Oscars
items.detail: At the 98th Academy Awards, 'One Battle After Another' won six Oscars including Best Picture and Best Director for Paul Thomas Anderson. Michael B. Jordan won Best Actor for 'Sinners' and Jessie Buckley became the first Irish winner of Best Actress for 'Hamnet'. A new Casting category was introduced.
examFacts: 98th Academy Awards Best Picture: One Battle After Another
First Irish Best Actress: Jessie Buckley (Hamnet)

items.headline: Kimi Antonelli takes first F1 win at Chinese Grand Prix
items.detail: Mercedes' 19-year-old Andrea Kimi Antonelli won the Chinese Grand Prix in Shanghai, his first Formula One career win, after George Russell won the season-opening Australian Grand Prix. Antonelli later won the Japanese Grand Prix too, becoming the youngest-ever F1 championship leader.
examFacts: 2026 Chinese GP winner (first career win): Kimi Antonelli
2026 season-opening Australian GP winner: George Russell

items.headline: ISRO fires CE20 engine at 22-tonne thrust
items.detail: ISRO completed a 165-second sea-level hot test of the CE20 cryogenic engine at 22-tonne thrust at Mahendragiri. The same engine set a record of 20 hot tests and will power the uprated C32 stage of the LVM3 rocket.
examFacts: CE20 cryogenic engine tested at: 22-tonne thrust
CE20 powers the LVM3 upper stage

items.headline: Quantum teaching labs approved in 23 institutions
items.detail: The government approved quantum teaching laboratories in 23 institutions under the National Quantum Mission. The review meeting was chaired by Dr Jitendra Singh.
examFacts: Institutions getting quantum labs under NQM: 23

items.headline: R. Vairamuthu gets 60th Jnanpith Award
items.detail: Tamil writer and lyricist R. Vairamuthu was chosen for the 60th Jnanpith Award (for 2025), becoming the third Tamil writer to receive it after Akilan and Jayakanthan. The Jnanpith carries a cash prize of Rs 11 lakh and a statue of Vagdevi.
examFacts: Jnanpith is given by the Bharatiya Jnanpith

items.headline: India tops World Para Athletics Grand Prix with 208 medals
items.detail: India finished on top of the New Delhi leg of the World Para Athletics Grand Prix with 208 medals, including 75 gold. Russia was second with 35 medals. The event served as a qualifier for the World Championships and the LA 2028 Paralympics.
examFacts: India's medal tally at New Delhi Para Athletics GP: 208 (75 gold)

items.headline: Mayank Chakraborty becomes India's 94th chess Grandmaster
items.detail: Seventeen-year-old Mayank Chakraborty of Guwahati became India's 94th Grandmaster and the first from North East India after completing his final norm in Sweden and crossing a 2500 FIDE rating.
examFacts: First GM from North East India: Mayank Chakraborty

items.headline: Dravid, Binny and Mithali get BCCI lifetime achievement awards
items.detail: At the BCCI Naman Awards, Rahul Dravid and Roger Binny received the C.K. Nayudu Lifetime Achievement Award and Mithali Raj the women's Lifetime Achievement Award. Shubman Gill won the Polly Umrigar Award and Smriti Mandhana was named best international woman cricketer for the fifth time.
examFacts: BCCI C.K. Nayudu Lifetime Achievement 2026: Rahul Dravid and Roger Binny

items.headline: Cabinet approves Rs 33,660 crore BHAVYA industrial parks scheme
items.detail: The Union Cabinet approved the BHAVYA scheme with an outlay of Rs 33,660 crore to build 100 plug-and-play industrial parks of 100-1,000 acres. The Centre will support up to Rs 1 crore per acre, with parks selected in challenge mode.

items.headline: Unemployment rate falls to 4.9%: PLFS
items.detail: The NSO's monthly PLFS bulletin showed India's unemployment rate fell to 4.9% in February 2026 from 5% in January. The urban unemployment rate was 6.6% while the rural rate stayed at 4.2%.

items.headline: National Dental Commission replaces Dental Council of India
items.detail: The National Dental Commission was constituted as a statutory body under the National Dental Commission Act 2023, which came into force on March 19, 2026, repealing the Dentists Act 1948. Dr Sanjay Tewari is its chairperson.
examFacts: National Dental Commission replaces: Dental Council of India
First NDC chairperson: Dr Sanjay Tewari

items.headline: Forbes 2026 list: Elon Musk world's richest again
items.detail: The Forbes World's Billionaires List 2026 counted 3,428 billionaires. Elon Musk stayed number one with USD 839 billion, while Mukesh Ambani remained India's richest at USD 99.7 billion. India had 229 billionaires, third after the USA (989) and China (539).
examFacts: Forbes richest person 2026: Elon Musk (USD 839 billion)

items.headline: Finland tops World Happiness Report; India 116th
items.detail: The World Happiness Report 2026 ranked Finland first for the ninth straight year. India stood 116th. The report is published by the Oxford Wellbeing Research Centre with Gallup and the UN Sustainable Development Solutions Network.
examFacts: World Happiness Report 2026 topper: Finland (9th time in a row)
India's rank in World Happiness Report 2026: 116th

items.headline: Shaheed Diwas marks Bhagat Singh's martyrdom
items.detail: Shaheed Diwas was observed on March 23 to honour Bhagat Singh, Shivaram Rajguru and Sukhdev Thapar, who were executed in Lahore Central Jail on March 23, 1931.
examFacts: Executed on 23 March 1931: Bhagat Singh, Rajguru, Sukhdev

items.headline: Kailash Satyarthi releases 'Karuna: The Power of Compassion'
items.detail: Nobel Peace laureate Kailash Satyarthi released his book 'Karuna: The Power of Compassion'. The Nobel Peace Prize 2014 was shared by Satyarthi and Malala Yousafzai.
examFacts: 'Karuna: The Power of Compassion' author: Kailash Satyarthi

items.headline: Pakistan tops Global Terrorism Index; India 13th
items.detail: The Global Terrorism Index 2026 placed Pakistan first with 1,139 deaths from terrorism, while India ranked 13th. Global deaths from terrorism fell 28% to 5,582. The index is released by the Institute for Economics and Peace.
examFacts: GTI is released by the Institute for Economics and Peace (Australia)

items.headline: Agnikul test-fires world's first fully 3D-printed booster engine
items.detail: Chennai-based space startup Agnikul Cosmos successfully test-fired 'Agnite', the world's first fully 3D-printed booster engine, at its Chennai launch pad.
examFacts: World's first fully 3D-printed booster engine: Agnite (Agnikul Cosmos)

items.headline: Gujarat becomes second state to pass Uniform Civil Code
items.detail: The Gujarat Assembly passed the Gujarat Uniform Civil Code, 2026, becoming the second state after Uttarakhand to enact it. The law mandates registration of live-in relationships and bans bigamy, with Scheduled Tribes excluded.
examFacts: Second state to pass UCC: Gujarat (after Uttarakhand)

items.headline: Cabinet approves revamped UDAN with Rs 28,840 crore
items.detail: The Union Cabinet approved a revamped regional connectivity scheme UDAN with an outlay of Rs 28,840 crore for ten years from FY27 to FY36. It targets about 120 new destinations and 4 crore more passengers.
examFacts: UDAN full form: Ude Desh ka Aam Naagrik

items.headline: MUFG to buy 20% of Shriram Finance for Rs 39,618 crore
items.detail: The CCI cleared Japan's MUFG Bank plan to acquire a 20% stake in Shriram Finance for about Rs 39,618 crore, the largest cross-border financial-sector investment in India.
examFacts: MUFG Bank stake in Shriram Finance: 20% (Rs 39,618 crore)
Deal cleared by: Competition Commission of India

items.headline: India's new climate pledge targets 60% clean capacity by 2035
items.detail: The Cabinet approved India's updated Nationally Determined Contribution for 2031-35. It promises to cut the emissions intensity of GDP by 47% from 2005 levels and raise non-fossil installed power capacity to 60% by 2035.
examFacts: Updated NDC target: 47% cut in emissions intensity by 2035
Updated NDC target: 60% non-fossil capacity by 2035

items.headline: Balendra Shah becomes Nepal's youngest Prime Minister
items.detail: Balendra Shah, 35, of the Rastriya Swatantra Party was sworn in as Nepal's Prime Minister, the country's youngest ever. A former rapper, his party won 182 of 275 House seats in the March 2026 elections.
examFacts: Balendra Shah's party: Rastriya Swatantra Party

items.headline: Noida International Airport Phase 1 inaugurated at Jewar
items.detail: Prime Minister Modi inaugurated Phase 1 of Noida International Airport at Jewar, Uttar Pradesh, built at a cost of Rs 11,200 crore with Zurich Airport International. It becomes Delhi-NCR's second international airport with 12 million passengers-a-year capacity.
examFacts: Noida International Airport location: Jewar, Uttar Pradesh
NIA Phase 1 cost: Rs 11,200 crore; partner: Zurich Airport

items.headline: Operation Urja Suraksha guards energy ships in Hormuz
items.detail: The Indian Navy launched Operation Urja Suraksha to escort India-bound energy ships through the Strait of Hormuz amid the West Asia conflict. Over five frontline warships are escorting 22 identified vessels carrying LNG, LPG and crude oil.
examFacts: Operation protects ships through the Strait of Hormuz

items.headline: India's first hydrogen train completes trial runs
items.detail: Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw said India's first hydrogen train had completed its oscillation trials on the Jind-Sonipat route in Haryana at 70 kmph. The train was built by the Integral Coach Factory, Chennai.
examFacts: India's first hydrogen train route: Jind-Sonipat (Haryana)
Hydrogen train built by: Integral Coach Factory, Chennai

items.headline: Sadhvi Niranjan Jyoti named NCBC chairperson
items.detail: Former Union Minister Sadhvi Niranjan Jyoti was appointed Chairperson of the National Commission for Backward Classes, succeeding Hansraj Gangaram Ahir.
examFacts: NCBC is a constitutional body (102nd Amendment)

items.headline: RBI releases Payments Vision 2028
items.detail: The RBI released 'Payment Vision 2028 - Shaping India's Payment Frontier' with 15 initiatives up to December 2028, including a digital payments switch on/off facility and cross-border single-window authorisation.

items.headline: Raymond ex-chairman Vijaypat Singhania dies at 87
items.detail: Vijaypat Singhania, former chairman of Raymond Group, died in Mumbai at 87. A Padma Bhushan awardee (2006), he set a hot air balloon altitude world record of 69,852 feet in 2005 and flew solo from London to Ahmedabad in 1988.
examFacts: His 2005 hot air balloon record: 69,852 feet

quiz.q: India won the ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2026 by defeating which team in the final?
quiz.solution: India beat New Zealand by 96 runs at the Narendra Modi Stadium, Ahmedabad on March 8, 2026. It was India's third T20 World Cup title.

quiz.q: Who was chosen for the 60th Jnanpith Award (for 2025)?
quiz.solution: Tamil writer R. Vairamuthu received the 60th Jnanpith Award, becoming the third Tamil writer to win it after Akilan and Jayakanthan.

quiz.q: Jal Jeevan Mission has been extended till which year with an outlay of Rs 8.69 lakh crore?
quiz.solution: The Union Cabinet extended the Jal Jeevan Mission till 2028 with a total outlay of Rs 8.69 lakh crore.

quiz.q: The BHAVYA scheme, approved in March 2026 with Rs 33,660 crore, aims to develop how many industrial parks?
quiz.solution: BHAVYA targets 100 plug-and-play industrial parks of 100-1,000 acres with central support of up to Rs 1 crore per acre.

quiz.q: What are the names of the mascots unveiled for India's first fully digital Census 2027?
quiz.solution: Home Minister Amit Shah unveiled the mascots Pragati and Vikas along with four digital tools developed by C-DAC.

quiz.q: Lt Gen Syed Ata Hasnain was appointed Governor of which state in March 2026?
quiz.solution: Lt Gen Syed Ata Hasnain (retired) was appointed Governor of Bihar, succeeding Arif Mohammed Khan.

quiz.q: According to SIPRI, India was which largest arms importer during 2021-25?
quiz.solution: SIPRI ranked India second with an 8.2% share of global arms imports, behind Ukraine (9.7%).

quiz.q: Who topped the Forbes World's Billionaires List 2026?
quiz.solution: Elon Musk topped the 2026 Forbes list with about USD 839 billion. Mukesh Ambani was India's richest at USD 99.7 billion.

quiz.q: Balendra Shah, who became the youngest Prime Minister of Nepal in March 2026, leads which party?
quiz.solution: Balendra Shah of the Rastriya Swatantra Party, a former rapper, was sworn in as Nepal's PM after his party won 182 of 275 seats.

quiz.q: India's updated Nationally Determined Contribution promises what share of non-fossil installed power capacity by 2035?
quiz.solution: The updated NDC for 2031-35 targets 60% non-fossil capacity and a 47% cut in emissions intensity of GDP from 2005 levels.

items.headline: WTO's 14th Ministerial Conference held in Yaounde, Cameroon
items.detail: The 14th WTO Ministerial Conference (MC14) was held from March 26 to 30, 2026 in Yaounde, Cameroon. Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal led India's team.

items.headline: Singapore Changi named world's best airport for 14th time
items.detail: Singapore Changi was named the world's best airport at the Skytrax World Airport Awards 2026. Delhi IGI was the top Indian airport at 28th.

items.headline: Vir Vikram Yadav appointed Director General of DGCA
items.detail: IAS officer Vir Vikram Yadav was appointed Director General of Civil Aviation.

items.headline: William Walsh named IndiGo CEO
items.detail: William Walsh, Director General of IATA and former head of British Airways and IAG, was named CEO of IndiGo from August 2026.

items.headline: Amaravati becomes the sole capital of Andhra Pradesh
items.detail: The Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation (Amendment) Act, 2026 received Presidential assent. It makes Amaravati the only capital, ending the three-capital plan.

items.headline: Prototype Fast Breeder Reactor at Kalpakkam reaches criticality
items.detail: India's 500 MWe Prototype Fast Breeder Reactor at Kalpakkam, Tamil Nadu reached first criticality. It was designed by IGCAR, is run by BHAVINI and uses uranium-plutonium MOX fuel.
examFacts: Part of stage 2 of India's nuclear programme

items.headline: India adds record 6.05 GW wind capacity in FY26
items.detail: India added a record 6.05 GW of wind power in FY26, taking total wind capacity above 56 GW. Gujarat, Karnataka and Maharashtra led.
examFacts: Wind capacity added in FY26: 6.05 GW

items.headline: Startup India Fund of Funds 2.0 of Rs 10,000 crore notified
items.detail: The Commerce Ministry notified a Rs 10,000 crore Fund of Funds 2.0 for deep tech and manufacturing startups, with SIDBI as the implementing agency.

items.headline: IMF raises India's FY27 growth forecast to 6.5%
items.detail: The IMF's April 2026 World Economic Outlook raised India's FY27 GDP growth forecast to 6.5%. It projected world growth at 3.1% for 2026.

items.headline: UPI processed 228.5 billion transactions in 2025
items.detail: A Worldline report said UPI processed 228.5 billion transactions worth Rs 299.74 trillion in 2025, up 33%.

items.headline: New gecko Cyrtodactylus raimonaensis found in Assam
items.detail: A new gecko species, Cyrtodactylus raimonaensis, was found in Kokrajhar district, Assam. It is named after Raimona National Park.
examFacts: Named after Raimona National Park, Assam

items.headline: John Ternus to succeed Tim Cook as Apple CEO
items.detail: Apple named John Ternus as its next CEO from September 1, 2026. Tim Cook will become Executive Chairman.
examFacts: Apple CEO from Sept 2026: John Ternus

items.headline: Aronyak Ghosh becomes India's 95th Grandmaster
items.detail: Aronyak Ghosh became India's 95th chess Grandmaster after scoring 7/9 at the Bangkok Chess Club Open 2026.

items.headline: Supreme Court declares safe road travel part of Article 21
items.detail: The Supreme Court declared the 'Right to Safe Road Travel' part of the right to life under Article 21.
examFacts: Right to safe road travel: part of Article 21

items.headline: Jordan joins ISA, CDRI and Global Biofuels Alliance
items.detail: Jordan formally joined three India-led initiatives: the International Solar Alliance, the Coalition for Disaster Resilient Infrastructure and the Global Biofuels Alliance.

items.headline: Skyroot's Vikram-1 private orbital rocket flagged off
items.detail: Telangana CM Revanth Reddy flagged off Vikram-1, India's first privately built orbital rocket, made by Skyroot Aerospace. It can carry 350 kg to low Earth orbit.

items.headline: Olympic hockey medallist Gurbax Singh Grewal dies at 84
items.detail: Gurbax Singh Grewal, a member of India's bronze-winning hockey team at the 1968 Mexico City Olympics, died at 84.

items.headline: Andhra Pradesh starts free electricity for handloom weavers
items.detail: From April 1, 2026, Andhra Pradesh gives 200 units a month of free electricity to handloom weavers and 500 units to powerloom operators.

items.headline: World Health Day 2026: 'Together for Health. Stand with Science'
items.detail: World Health Day was observed on April 7, the founding day of WHO in 1948. The 2026 theme was 'Together for Health. Stand with Science'.

items.headline: Assembly elections held in Assam, Kerala and Puducherry
items.detail: Assembly elections were held in Assam, Kerala and Puducherry on April 9, 2026. The BJP kept its majority in Assam and the UDF won a majority in Kerala.

items.headline: Ayush Shetty wins silver at Badminton Asia Championships
items.detail: Ayush Shetty won men's singles silver at the 43rd Badminton Asia Championships in Ningbo, China. He was the first Indian in 61 years to reach the men's final.

items.headline: 9th Indian Ocean Conference held in Mauritius
items.detail: The 9th Indian Ocean Conference was held in Port Louis, Mauritius, from April 10 to 12, with the theme 'Collective Stewardship for Indian Ocean Governance'.
examFacts: 9th Indian Ocean Conference: Port Louis, Mauritius

items.headline: PM inaugurates Delhi-Dehradun Economic Corridor
items.detail: PM Modi inaugurated the 213-km six-lane Delhi-Dehradun Economic Corridor, built at Rs 12,000 crore. It has a 12-km elevated wildlife section.

items.headline: India's first open-access quantum reference facility opens in Amaravati
items.detail: Andhra CM Chandrababu Naidu inaugurated India's first open-access Quantum Reference Facility in Amaravati.

items.headline: Samrat Choudhary becomes Chief Minister of Bihar
items.detail: Nitish Kumar resigned as Bihar Chief Minister to move to the Rajya Sabha, and Samrat Choudhary became the new Chief Minister on April 14, 2026.
examFacts: Bihar CM from April 2026: Samrat Choudhary

items.headline: Delimitation Bill and Constitution Amendment Bill fail in Parliament
items.detail: The Delimitation Bill and a Constitution Amendment Bill failed to pass in Parliament on April 17, 2026.

items.headline: DA raised by 2% to 60% for central employees
items.detail: The Union Cabinet raised Dearness Allowance and Dearness Relief by 2 percentage points, from 58% to 60%, effective January 1, 2026.

items.headline: India's first petroglyph conservation park set up in Leh
items.detail: India's first petroglyph conservation park was set up at Sindhu Ghat, Leh, Ladakh on World Heritage Day, April 18.
examFacts: First petroglyph conservation park: Sindhu Ghat, Leh

items.headline: National Civil Services Day observed on April 21
items.detail: Civil Services Day marks Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel's address to civil servants in 1947.

items.headline: Tamil Nadu and West Bengal hold Assembly elections
items.detail: Tamil Nadu voted on April 23 and West Bengal voted between April 23 and 29, 2026. TVK became the largest party in Tamil Nadu and the BJP won a landslide in West Bengal.

items.headline: World IP Day 2026 on 'IP and Sports'
items.detail: World Intellectual Property Day was observed on April 26 with the theme 'IP and Sports: Ready, Set, Innovate'.

items.headline: India and New Zealand sign Free Trade Agreement
items.detail: India and New Zealand signed an FTA in New Delhi on April 28, 2026. India gets duty-free access on all 8,284 tariff lines, and New Zealand committed USD 20 billion of investment over 15 years.
examFacts: NZ investment pledge: USD 20 billion over 15 years

quiz.q: The Prototype Fast Breeder Reactor that reached criticality in April 2026 is located at:
quiz.solution: The 500 MWe PFBR at Kalpakkam, Tamil Nadu, reached first criticality.

quiz.q: Which city became the sole capital of Andhra Pradesh by law in 2026?
quiz.solution: The AP Reorganisation (Amendment) Act, 2026 made Amaravati the only capital.

quiz.q: Who became Chief Minister of Bihar in April 2026?
quiz.solution: Samrat Choudhary took over after Nitish Kumar moved to the Rajya Sabha.

quiz.q: India signed a Free Trade Agreement with which country on April 28, 2026?
quiz.solution: India and New Zealand signed an FTA in New Delhi.

quiz.q: What is the length of the Delhi-Dehradun Economic Corridor inaugurated in April 2026?
quiz.solution: The six-lane corridor is 213 km long.

quiz.q: After the April 2026 hike, Dearness Allowance for central employees stands at:
quiz.solution: DA was raised from 58% to 60% from January 1, 2026.

quiz.q: Which airport was ranked world's best in the Skytrax awards 2026?
quiz.solution: Singapore Changi won for the 14th time.

quiz.solution: Aronyak Ghosh became India's 95th GM in April 2026.

items.headline: South Coast Railway becomes India's 18th railway zone
items.detail: The new South Coast Railway zone, with headquarters at Visakhapatnam, became operational from June 1, 2026. It has Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada and Guntur divisions.

items.headline: Indian journalists win Pulitzer Prize for Illustrated Reporting
items.detail: At the 110th Pulitzer Prizes, Indian journalists Anand RK and Suparna Sharma won in the Illustrated Reporting category for 'trAPPed', a cybercrime report, with Bloomberg.
examFacts: Pulitzer 2026 Illustrated Reporting: Anand RK and Suparna Sharma

items.headline: Prasoon Joshi appointed Chairman of Prasar Bharati
items.detail: Lyricist Prasoon Joshi was appointed Chairman of Prasar Bharati. He was earlier the Chairperson of CBFC.

items.headline: Alex Zanardi, F1 driver and Paralympic champion, dies at 59
items.detail: Italian racing driver Alex Zanardi, who won four Paralympic gold medals in para-cycling after losing his legs, died at 59.

items.headline: SEHAT Mission launched to link farming and health
items.detail: J.P. Nadda and Shivraj Singh Chouhan launched the SEHAT Mission, a joint effort of ICAR and ICMR to link agriculture, nutrition and public health.

items.headline: CJI launches 'One Case One Data' and AI chatbot Su Sahay
items.detail: CJI Surya Kant announced the 'One Case One Data' initiative giving each case a single digital ID, and the AI chatbot 'Su Sahay' built by NIC.

items.headline: Army inducts ULPGM and AGNIKAA kamikaze drone
items.detail: The Indian Army inducted the UAV-Launched Precision Guided Munition (ULPGM) and the AGNIKAA VTOL-1 FPV kamikaze drone, co-developed by DRDO and Adani Defence.

items.headline: Punjab launches Meri Rasoi Yojana for free food kits
items.detail: Punjab CM Bhagwant Mann launched Meri Rasoi Yojana in Sangrur to give free food kits to 40 lakh poor families every three months.

items.headline: Rs 175 crore Coffee of Nagaland Mission launched
items.detail: Jyotiraditya Scindia launched the Rs 175 crore Coffee of Nagaland Mission for coffee cultivation, branding and export.
examFacts: Coffee of Nagaland Mission: Rs 175 crore (MDoNER)

items.headline: AMCA programme facility launched at Puttaparthi
items.detail: Rajnath Singh and Andhra CM Chandrababu Naidu launched the Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft programme facility at Puttaparthi, Sri Sathya Sai district, costing Rs 15,000 crore.
examFacts: AMCA = Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft (5th generation)

items.headline: Saurabh Vijay appointed CEO of UIDAI
items.detail: Saurabh Vijay was appointed Chief Executive Officer of the Unique Identification Authority of India.

items.headline: Rohit Rajpal named India's Chef de Mission for Glasgow CWG
items.detail: Former Davis Cup captain Rohit Rajpal was named Chef de Mission for India at the 2026 Commonwealth Games in Glasgow.
examFacts: India's CWG 2026 Chef de Mission: Rohit Rajpal

items.headline: China win Thomas Cup, South Korea win Uber Cup 2026
items.detail: The Thomas and Uber Cup Finals were held in Horsens, Denmark. China's men beat France 3-1 for their 13th Thomas Cup title, and South Korea's women beat China 3-1 for their 3rd Uber Cup.

items.headline: World Laughter Day observed on first Sunday of May
items.detail: World Laughter Day was founded in 1998 by Mumbai doctor Madan Kataria. The 2026 theme was 'World Peace through Laughter'.
examFacts: World Laughter Day founder: Dr. Madan Kataria (1998)

items.headline: NSE launches Electronic Gold Receipts segment
items.detail: The National Stock Exchange launched an Electronic Gold Receipts (EGR) segment on May 4, 2026. EGRs are SEBI-approved demat securities backed by physical gold.

items.headline: Suvendu Adhikari sworn in as West Bengal Chief Minister
items.detail: After the BJP's big win in the West Bengal Assembly election, Suvendu Adhikari was sworn in as Chief Minister on May 9, 2026.

items.headline: Actor Vijay sworn in as Tamil Nadu Chief Minister
items.detail: Actor Vijay of Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) took oath as Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu on May 10, 2026. TVK emerged as the largest party in the Assembly election.
examFacts: Tamil Nadu CM: C. Joseph Vijay (TVK)

items.headline: PM releases Rs 75 coin at Somnath Amrut Mahotsav
items.detail: PM Modi took part in the Somnath Amrut Mahotsav and released a stamp and a Rs 75 coin marking 1,000 years of the Somnath temple.
examFacts: Rs 75 coin released for Somnath Amrut Mahotsav

items.headline: PMGSY-IV launched in Madhya Pradesh
items.detail: Shivraj Singh Chouhan launched PMGSY-IV works in Sehore district, approving 973 roads covering 2,117 km.
examFacts: PMGSY = Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana

items.headline: National Technology Day marks Pokhran tests
items.detail: National Technology Day on May 11 marks the 1998 Pokhran nuclear tests. The 2026 theme was 'Responsible Innovation for Inclusive Growth'.

items.headline: NTA cancels NEET-UG 2026 over paper leak
items.detail: The National Testing Agency cancelled the NEET (Undergraduate) 2026 exam on May 12 because of a question paper leak.

items.headline: V.D. Satheesan becomes Kerala Chief Minister
items.detail: V.D. Satheesan of the Congress-led UDF became Kerala's 13th Chief Minister, succeeding Pinarayi Vijayan. Governor Rajendra Arlekar administered the oath.

items.headline: Sinner and Svitolina win Italian Open 2026
items.detail: Jannik Sinner beat Casper Ruud to win the men's title at the Italian Open in Rome. Elina Svitolina beat Coco Gauff in the women's final.

items.headline: World Telecommunication Day marks ITU founding
items.detail: World Telecommunication and Information Society Day is observed on May 17, the day ITU was founded in 1865.

items.headline: RBI removes Investment Fluctuation Reserve requirement
items.detail: RBI discontinued the Investment Fluctuation Reserve requirement for banks from May 18, 2026, saying existing capital rules were enough.

items.headline: 79th World Health Assembly adopts first-ever resolution on stroke
items.detail: The 79th World Health Assembly was held in Geneva from May 18 to 23 with the theme 'Reshaping Global Health: A Shared Responsibility'. It adopted the first-ever resolution on stroke.

items.headline: Cyprus President visits India; ties raised to Strategic Partnership
items.detail: Cyprus President Nikos Christodoulides visited India from May 20 to 23. The two countries raised ties to a Strategic Partnership and agreed a 5-year defence roadmap.

items.headline: Saudi Arabia joins International Big Cat Alliance as 26th member
items.detail: At an IBCA pre-summit in Bhopal on May 22, Saudi Arabia joined the International Big Cat Alliance as its 26th member.

items.headline: Supreme Court upholds Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls
items.detail: The Supreme Court upheld the constitutional validity of the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls on May 27, 2026.
examFacts: SIR = Special Intensive Revision of voter lists

items.headline: D.K. Shivakumar chosen as Karnataka Chief Minister
items.detail: D.K. Shivakumar was selected as the new Chief Minister of Karnataka on May 28, 2026, replacing Siddaramaiah.

quiz.solution: China beat France 3-1 for its 13th Thomas Cup title.

quiz.solution: South Coast Railway, India's 18th zone, is headquartered at Visakhapatnam.

quiz.solution: Lyricist Prasoon Joshi was appointed Prasar Bharati Chairman.

quiz.solution: Saudi Arabia joined IBCA as its 26th member at the Bhopal pre-summit.

quiz.solution: The AMCA facility is at Puttaparthi in Sri Sathya Sai district, Andhra Pradesh.

quiz.solution: V.D. Satheesan of the UDF became Kerala's 13th Chief Minister.

quiz.solution: Jannik Sinner beat Casper Ruud 6-4, 6-4 in Rome.

items.headline: MAHA Water Mission launched with Rs 200 crore
items.detail: The Ministry of Jal Shakti and the Anusandhan National Research Foundation launched the MAHA Water Mission with Rs 200 crore over 5 years for water research.
examFacts: MAHA Water Mission: Jal Shakti + ANRF

items.headline: RBI Annual Report: balance sheet grows 20.6% to Rs 91.97 lakh crore
items.detail: RBI's Annual Report 2025-26 showed its balance sheet grew 20.6% to Rs 91.97 lakh crore. Bank fraud cases rose 46% to Rs 48,021 crore.
examFacts: RBI balance sheet 2025-26: Rs 91.97 lakh crore

items.headline: New lizard species Mesalina bishnoi found in Bikaner
items.detail: A new lizard species, Mesalina bishnoi, was discovered at Gajner in Bikaner, Rajasthan. It is the first record of genus Mesalina in India and honours the Bishnoi community.

items.headline: BHAVYA portal launched for 100 industrial parks
items.detail: Piyush Goyal launched the BHAVYA portal for a Rs 33,660 crore scheme to build 100 world-class industrial parks with the states.

items.headline: SIPRI: India is 5th largest military spender
items.detail: SIPRI data showed India was the fifth largest military spender in 2025 at USD 92.1 billion. India had 190 nuclear warheads as of January 2026. The USA spent the most.

items.headline: RBI recognises Sahamati Foundation as SRO for Account Aggregators
items.detail: RBI recognised the Sahamati Foundation as a Self-Regulatory Organisation for the Account Aggregator ecosystem, which has 17 operational AAs.
examFacts: SRO for Account Aggregators: Sahamati Foundation

items.headline: Swaminathan J. reappointed RBI Deputy Governor
items.detail: Swaminathan Janakiraman was reappointed as RBI Deputy Governor for two years from June 26, 2026. RBI has four Deputy Governors.

items.headline: Kimi Antonelli becomes youngest Monaco Grand Prix winner
items.detail: Andrea Kimi Antonelli of Mercedes, aged 19, won the 2026 Monaco Grand Prix and became its youngest winner in history.

items.headline: New WPI and PPI series released with base year 2022-23
items.detail: DPIIT released the revised Wholesale Price Index and a new Producer Price Index with base year 2022-23, replacing the 2011-12 series.

items.headline: India ranks 12th in WIPO PCT patent filings
items.detail: India ranked 12th in the world with 3,070 PCT patent applications in 2025. Jio Platforms was the only Indian company in the global top 20 filers. China led.

items.headline: Lt Vishal Kumar wins Sword of Honour at IMA
items.detail: Lt Vishal Kumar from Patna won the Sword of Honour and the President's Gold Medal at the Indian Military Academy passing out parade.
examFacts: IMA Sword of Honour June 2026: Vishal Kumar

items.headline: Sarvam AI becomes India's 130th unicorn
items.detail: Sarvam AI became India's 130th unicorn after raising USD 234 million at a valuation of USD 1.5 billion.

items.headline: Kerala launches free bus travel for women under Priyadarshini scheme
items.detail: Kerala CM V.D. Satheesan launched the Priyadarshini scheme for free travel for women and transgender persons in KSRTC ordinary buses.

items.headline: FAO SOFIA 2026: India 2nd in aquatic animal production
items.detail: FAO's State of World Fisheries and Aquaculture 2026 report ranked India second in aquatic animal production with 9% of the world total. India leads in inland water catches.
examFacts: India leads in inland fish catch

items.headline: Four Madhya Pradesh products get GI tags
items.detail: Four products from Madhya Pradesh got GI tags: Khurasani Imli of Mandu, Balam Kakdi and Garadu of Ratlam, and Malwi Potato.

items.headline: India's women win 4x100m relay gold at Asian Relays
items.detail: India's women's 4x100m relay team won gold in 43.85 seconds at the Asian Relays Championships in Shangyu, China. Chandigarh will host the 2027 edition.

items.headline: Book 'IIT: The Story of India's Most Prestigious Educational Ecosystem' launched
items.detail: Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla launched the book by IRS officer Prabhat Kumar on the 75-year history of IITs, published by HarperCollins India.
examFacts: First IIT started at Hijli (Kharagpur) in 1951

items.headline: India-Oman CEPA comes into force
items.detail: The India-Oman Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement came into force on June 1, 2026. It gives duty-free access to 99.38% of Indian exports and covers 127 service sub-sectors.
examFacts: Duty-free access for 99.38% of Indian exports

items.headline: World Milk Day 2026 celebrates women farmers
items.detail: World Milk Day was observed on June 1 with the theme 'Celebrating Women Farmers'. It was set up by FAO in 2001.

items.headline: Savitha Shri Baskar wins Asian women's chess title
items.detail: India's Savitha Shri Baskar won gold in the women's section of the Asian Individual Chess Championship in Ulaanbaatar with 7.5/9.
examFacts: Asian women's chess champion 2026: Savitha Shri Baskar

items.headline: India tops World Yogasana Championship in Ahmedabad
items.detail: India won 114 medals, including 102 gold, at the World Yogasana Championship 2026 at EKA Arena, Ahmedabad, held June 4-8.

items.headline: DRDO tests Long Range Land Attack Cruise Missile
items.detail: DRDO successfully tested the indigenous Long Range Land Attack Cruise Missile from Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Island, Odisha. Its expected range is 1,500 km.

items.headline: Global Wind Day observed; WT-MARUT portal launched
items.detail: Global Wind Day was observed on June 15. Minister Pralhad Joshi launched the WT-MARUT portal. India targets 100 GW of wind capacity by 2030.

items.headline: PM launches Rs 47,600 crore projects in Odisha
items.detail: PM Modi inaugurated or laid the foundation for 72 projects worth Rs 47,600 crore at Rairangpur, Mayurbhanj. India's first commercial coal-to-ammonium nitrate project was started at Lakhanpur.
examFacts: First commercial coal-to-ammonium nitrate project: Lakhanpur, Odisha

items.headline: 23rd PM-KISAN instalment released
items.detail: PM Modi released the 23rd instalment of PM-KISAN during his visit to West Bengal.

examFacts: World Music Day: 21 June, started in France (1982)

items.detail: General Dhiraj Seth took over as Chief of the Army Staff on June 30, 2026.
examFacts: Chief of Army Staff from 30 June 2026: Gen Dhiraj Seth

quiz.solution: The India-Oman CEPA came into force on June 1, 2026.

quiz.solution: General Dhiraj Seth became Chief of Army Staff on June 30, 2026.

quiz.solution: Sarvam AI became a unicorn at a USD 1.5 billion valuation.

quiz.solution: It was found at Gajner in Bikaner, Rajasthan.
