quiz.solution: India ranks 2nd with 9% of world aquatic animal production.

items.headline: 90 crore ABHA accounts; Aarogya Setu 2.0 launched
items.detail: Health Minister J.P. Nadda launched Aarogya Setu 2.0 and other digital health tools. India has created 90 crore ABHA health accounts.

items.headline: Small savings rates unchanged for 9th straight quarter
items.detail: The Finance Ministry kept interest rates on small savings schemes unchanged for July-September 2026, the ninth quarter in a row without change.
examFacts: Small savings rates last changed: December 2024

items.headline: Ravi Agrawal gets extension as CBDT Chairman
items.detail: Ravi Agrawal was reappointed as Chairman of the Central Board of Direct Taxes for six months, from July 1 to December 31, 2026.

items.headline: India's first GAGAN-based satellite landing trial at Udaipur
items.detail: DGCA conducted India's first satellite-based landing trial with an IndiGo A320 at Udaipur airport using GAGAN and LPV approach.
examFacts: Trial at Maharana Pratap Airport, Udaipur

items.headline: Theatre legend Vijaya Mehta dies at 92
items.detail: Marathi theatre and film legend Vijaya Mehta, co-founder of Rangayan and Padma Shri awardee (1987), died in Mumbai at 92.
examFacts: Vijaya Mehta: co-founder of theatre group Rangayan

items.headline: UDISE+ 2025-26: over 1 crore school teachers
items.detail: The UDISE+ 2025-26 report showed the number of teachers rose to 1,02,73,020. Gross Enrolment Ratio at the secondary level rose to 71.7%.

items.headline: India ranked 11th in FDI inflows in UNCTAD World Investment Report 2026
items.detail: India ranked 11th globally in FDI inflows with USD 38.89 billion, a 44% rise. The USA was first, followed by Singapore and Hong Kong.

items.headline: Sirsa Kinnow becomes Haryana's first GI-tagged fruit
items.detail: Sirsa Kinnow received a GI tag, becoming Haryana's first GI-tagged fruit. India now has 822 GI products.
examFacts: Haryana's first GI fruit: Sirsa Kinnow

items.headline: Indian Air Force ranked 3rd in the world by WDMMA
items.detail: The Indian Air Force was ranked third in the world in the WDMMA 2026 ranking, ahead of China, for the fifth year in a row.

items.headline: Codex Commission adopts standards for cardamom, coriander, curry leaves
items.detail: The 49th Codex Alimentarius Commission in Geneva adopted seven standards under India's leadership, including for coriander, curry leaves, vanilla and cardamom.
examFacts: Codex Alimentarius sets international food standards (FAO-WHO)

items.headline: Unjha cumin and fennel of Gujarat get GI tags
items.detail: Unjha cumin and Unjha fennel from Gujarat received GI tags. Unjha is Asia's largest fennel trading hub.

items.headline: Anil Menon flies to ISS on Soyuz MS-29
items.detail: Russia's Soyuz MS-29 carried NASA astronaut Anil Menon and two cosmonauts to the International Space Station for Expedition 75.
examFacts: Soyuz MS-29 carried Anil Menon to the ISS

items.headline: Mission Golden Spice launched for Lakadong turmeric in Meghalaya
items.detail: A Rs 175.45 crore Mission Golden Spice was launched for Lakadong turmeric of Meghalaya for 2025-2030, covering the Jaintia Hills.

items.headline: Navy commissions INS Malvan at Karwar
items.detail: The Indian Navy commissioned INS Malvan, the second Mahe-class anti-submarine warfare shallow water craft, at Naval Base Karwar. It has over 80% indigenous content.
examFacts: INS Malvan: 2nd Mahe-class ASW shallow water craft

items.headline: India is the world's second-largest supplier of seafarers
items.detail: The BIMCO-ICS Seafarer Workforce Report 2026 showed India supplies 3,11,936 seafarers (12.16% of the world total), second only to the Philippines.

items.headline: ADB approves USD 850 million loan for PM Surya Ghar rooftop solar
items.detail: The Asian Development Bank approved an USD 850 million loan to support PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana.
examFacts: ADB loan for PM Surya Ghar: USD 850 million

items.headline: Satya Pal Kumar appointed Director of FIU-IND
items.detail: IRS officer Satya Pal Kumar was appointed Director of the Financial Intelligence Unit-India.

items.headline: Delhi Lakshmi Yojana to give Rs 2,500 a month to women
items.detail: Delhi's Lakshmi Yojana will give Rs 2,500 per month to eligible women aged 21-60, with a 2026-27 budget of Rs 5,110 crore.
examFacts: Delhi Lakshmi Yojana: Rs 2,500 per month to women

items.headline: Chhattisgarh launches DWEEPTI Yojana, India's first women-led renewable energy policy
items.detail: Chhattisgarh launched DWEEPTI Yojana, India's first women-led distributed renewable energy policy, targeting 50,000 green jobs.

items.headline: VB-G RAM G law replaces MGNREGA
items.detail: The VB-G RAM G law came into force on July 1, 2026, replacing MGNREGA. On July 5, Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan released the first instalment of Rs 25,863 crore under it.
examFacts: VB-G RAM G replaced MGNREGA from 1 July 2026

items.headline: National Doctors' Day observed on July 1
items.detail: National Doctors' Day honours Dr. Bidhan Chandra Roy, former Chief Minister of West Bengal. The 2026 theme was 'Behind the Mask: Who Heals the Healers?'.

items.headline: Chartered Accountants Day marks ICAI foundation
items.detail: Chartered Accountants Day on July 1 marks the setting up of ICAI in 1949. 2026 was its 78th foundation anniversary.
examFacts: ICAI set up in 1949 under the Chartered Accountants Act

items.headline: ISRO hot-tests CE20 cryogenic engine with nozzle protection system
items.detail: ISRO hot-tested the CE20 cryogenic engine at IPRC Mahendragiri, Tamil Nadu, on July 6. A Nozzle Protection System was tested for the first time. The engine powers LVM3.
examFacts: CE20 engine powers the upper stage of LVM3

items.headline: Jalalabad in Shahjahanpur renamed Parashurampuri
items.detail: Jalalabad in Shahjahanpur district of Uttar Pradesh was renamed Parashurampuri, believed to be the birthplace of Lord Parashuram.

items.headline: India and Australia sign defence and uranium export agreement
items.detail: India and Australia signed an agreement covering defence and uranium exports on July 9, 2026.

items.headline: All five Indian students win gold at International Physics Olympiad
items.detail: All five members of India's team won gold medals at the 56th International Physics Olympiad in Bucaramanga, Colombia, held July 4-12.

items.headline: India 4th at inaugural Asian U23 Athletics Championships
items.detail: China topped the first Asian U23 Athletics Championships in Ordos. India won 16 medals (3 gold) and finished fourth. Anand Singh won men's javelin gold with 80.57 m.

items.headline: World Brain Day observed on July 22
items.detail: World Brain Day 2026 had the theme 'Brain Health: Access for All'. July 22 is also Pi Approximation Day (22/7).
examFacts: World Brain Day theme 2026: Brain Health: Access for All

items.headline: Sonam Wangchuk ends 26-day hunger strike
items.detail: Climate activist Sonam Wangchuk ended his 26-day hunger strike on July 23, 2026.

items.headline: Pralhad Joshi becomes Education Minister after Pradhan resigns
items.detail: Dharmendra Pradhan resigned as Union Education Minister on July 25, 2026, and was replaced by Pralhad Joshi.
examFacts: New Union Education Minister: Pralhad Joshi

items.headline: Sarnath declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site
items.detail: Sarnath in Uttar Pradesh, where the Buddha gave his first sermon, was designated a UNESCO World Heritage Site on July 25, 2026.
examFacts: Sarnath (Uttar Pradesh): UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2026

items.headline: President Murmu completes four years in office
items.detail: President Droupadi Murmu, India's 15th President and first tribal head of state, completed four years in office and launched five initiatives including e-Upahaar and RAAHI.
examFacts: Droupadi Murmu: 15th President, took oath 25 July 2022

items.headline: World Nature Conservation Day observed on July 28
items.detail: World Nature Conservation Day is observed on July 28 to promote the protection of natural resources.

examFacts: Anti Paper Leak Bill passed on 30 July 2026

quiz.solution: The VB-G RAM G law came into force on July 1, 2026, replacing MGNREGA.

Led first winter ascent of K2 (2021)

items.headline: PLFS: unemployment rate at 5.4% in April-June 2026
items.detail: The Periodic Labour Force Survey quarterly bulletin showed an unemployment rate of 5.4% for April-June 2026. The labour force participation rate was 54.6%.

items.headline: PM E-DRIVE incentive for electric two-wheelers reduced
items.detail: The Ministry of Heavy Industries cut the incentive for electric two-wheelers under PM E-DRIVE to Rs 2,500 per kWh, capped at Rs 5,000 per vehicle. The scheme outlay is Rs 11,900 crore.
examFacts: Implemented by Ministry of Heavy Industries

items.headline: GeM marks 10 years; helpdesk code 14550 launched
items.detail: Government e-Marketplace (GeM) completed 10 years. Piyush Goyal launched a 5-digit helpdesk number 14550 at Bharat Mandapam.

items.headline: Deepak Dhar becomes first Indian to win the Dirac Medal
items.detail: Physicist Deepak Dhar, a Padma Bhushan awardee, became the first Indian to win the Dirac Medal (ICTP) for his work in statistical mechanics. He shared it with three other scientists.

items.headline: V.O. Chidambaranar Port becomes first in India with ISO 50001 certification
items.detail: V.O. Chidambaranar Port in Thoothukudi, Tamil Nadu became India's first port to get ISO 50001:2018 energy management certification. Renewable energy met about 94% of its power needs in FY26.

items.headline: NITI Aayog report names 12 manufacturing sectors for global hub status
items.detail: A NITI Aayog report identified 12 key manufacturing sectors. Chemicals, textiles, telecom equipment and solar PV were named as four high-potential sectors.
examFacts: NITI Aayog report: 12 key manufacturing sectors

items.headline: IN-SPACe approves India's first fully commercial Earth observation constellation
items.detail: IN-SPACe approved Allied Orbits Private Limited to build a 12-satellite Earth observation constellation, to be operational by 2029.
examFacts: First fully commercial EO constellation: Allied Orbits (12 satellites)

items.headline: N. Chandrasekaran to step down as Tata Sons Chairman in 2027
items.detail: Natarajan Chandrasekaran announced he will retire as Executive Chairman of Tata Sons on February 20, 2027, after leading the group since 2017.
examFacts: Tata Sons Chairman since 2017: N. Chandrasekaran

items.headline: India launches grasslands guide at UNCCD COP17 in Mongolia
items.detail: India launched its first Guide to Grasslands and Other Open Natural Ecosystems at UNCCD COP17 in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia.

items.headline: India and Armenia sign defence industrial partnership MoU
items.detail: India's Ministry of Defence signed an MoU with Armenia on defence industrial partnership in Yerevan.
examFacts: India-Armenia defence MoU signed in Yerevan

items.headline: Hakainde Hichilema re-elected President of Zambia
items.detail: Hakainde Hichilema won a second term as President of Zambia with 61.4% of the vote.

items.headline: Mission Samriddh Gaon launched for poverty-free villages
items.detail: Rural Development Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan launched Mission Samriddh Gaon to create poverty-free villages. Pilots are in Budni and Khategaon blocks of Madhya Pradesh.
examFacts: Mission Samriddh Gaon: Ministry of Rural Development

items.headline: 11 airports approved for third round of privatisation
items.detail: The PPPAC approved leasing of 11 airports, including Amritsar, Varanasi, Bhubaneswar and Tirupati, in 5 bundles for 50 years.

items.headline: India-Vietnam coast guard exercise Sahyog Hop Tac held in Chennai
items.detail: The second edition of Sahyog Hop Tac, a joint exercise between the Indian and Vietnam coast guards, was held in Chennai.
examFacts: Sahyog Hop Tac: India-Vietnam coast guard exercise

items.headline: Vice President launches first indigenous non-GM popcorn maize hybrid
items.detail: Vice President C.P. Radhakrishnan launched India's first indigenous non-GMO popcorn maize hybrid at Musunuru in Eluru district, Andhra Pradesh. It was developed by ICAR-IIMR.
examFacts: Developed by ICAR-Indian Institute of Maize Research

items.headline: Singer Dolly Parton dies at 80
items.detail: American singer and songwriter Dolly Parton, known for 'Jolene' and 'I Will Always Love You', died at 80. She won 10 Grammy Awards.
examFacts: Dolly Parton: American country singer, 10 Grammys

items.headline: PM inaugurates Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport at Bhogapuram
items.detail: PM Narendra Modi inaugurated the Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport at Bhogapuram in Vizianagaram, Andhra Pradesh, built at a cost of Rs 5,640 crore. He also laid the foundation of a Rs 2,500 crore semiconductor project in Visakhapatnam.
examFacts: Bhogapuram airport named after Alluri Sitarama Raju
Located in Vizianagaram district, Andhra Pradesh

items.headline: NSA Ajit Doval receives Lokmanya Tilak National Award
items.detail: Home Minister Amit Shah presented the Lokmanya Tilak National Award to National Security Adviser Ajit Doval.
examFacts: Lokmanya Tilak National Award 2026: Ajit Doval

items.headline: India finishes 4th at Glasgow Commonwealth Games 2026
items.detail: The Commonwealth Games were held in Glasgow from July 23 to August 2 with 10 sports. India won 39 medals (13 gold, 17 silver, 9 bronze) and finished fourth. Australia topped with 171 medals.

items.headline: Indian Organ Donation Day observed on August 3
items.detail: Indian Organ Donation Day marks India's first heart transplant on August 3, 1994. The 'Jug Jug Jiyo' campaign was launched.

items.headline: President presents Sangeet Natak Akademi Awards
items.detail: President Droupadi Murmu presented the Sangeet Natak Akademi Fellowships and Awards for 2024 and 2025.
examFacts: Sangeet Natak Akademi awards presented by the President

items.headline: Partition Horrors Remembrance Day observed on August 14
items.detail: Partition Horrors Remembrance Day is observed every year on August 14. It was declared in 2021.

items.headline: 80th Independence Day: PM's 13th straight Red Fort speech
items.detail: PM Modi addressed the nation from the Red Fort for the 13th consecutive time. The themes included 150 years of 'Vande Mataram'. He announced a target of 100 GW nuclear power capacity by 2047.

items.headline: Bengali filmmaker Raja Sen dies at 71
items.detail: Bengali film director Raja Sen died on August 16, 2026. He won three National Film Awards.
examFacts: Raja Sen: Bengali filmmaker, 3 National Film Awards

items.headline: World Humanitarian Day observed on August 19
items.detail: World Humanitarian Day marks the 2003 Canal Hotel bombing in Baghdad in which 22 people were killed.

items.headline: Rajnath Singh allows transfer of DRDO missile technology to private firms
items.detail: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh approved the transfer of DRDO conventional missile technology to Indian defence manufacturers, including private companies.
examFacts: DRDO missile tech transfer approved to Indian industry

quiz.q: How many medals did India win at the 2026 Commonwealth Games in Glasgow?
quiz.solution: India won 39 medals (13 gold, 17 silver, 9 bronze) and finished fourth.

quiz.q: The Pithora painting that received a GI tag in 2026 belongs to which state?
quiz.solution: Pithora wall art is from Chhota Udepur, Gujarat.

quiz.q: Who became the first Indian to receive the Dirac Medal in 2026?
quiz.solution: Physicist Deepak Dhar won the Dirac Medal 2026 for statistical mechanics.

quiz.q: Who received the Lokmanya Tilak National Award in August 2026?
quiz.solution: Amit Shah presented the award to NSA Ajit Doval.

quiz.q: The Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport inaugurated in August 2026 is at which place?
quiz.solution: The airport is at Bhogapuram in Vizianagaram district, Andhra Pradesh.

quiz.q: According to the PLFS bulletin for April-June 2026, what was India's unemployment rate?
quiz.solution: The PLFS quarterly bulletin showed an unemployment rate of 5.4%.

quiz.q: Which was India's first port to get ISO 50001:2018 certification?
quiz.solution: V.O. Chidambaranar Port, Thoothukudi, got ISO 50001:2018 certification.

quiz.q: World Humanitarian Day is observed on which date?
quiz.solution: World Humanitarian Day is on August 19, marking the 2003 Baghdad bombing.

quiz.q: UNCCD COP17 was held in which city?
quiz.solution: India launched a grasslands guide at UNCCD COP17 in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia.

items.headline: MoSPI releases National Accounts Statistics with new base year 2022-23
items.detail: The Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation released the National Accounts Statistics 2026 using 2022-23 as the new base year. It has 60 statements covering FY23, FY24 and FY25.
examFacts: New base year of National Accounts: 2022-23

items.headline: AISHE reports show universities rise to 1,289
items.detail: The Ministry of Education released AISHE reports for 2022-23 and 2023-24. The number of universities rose from 760 to 1,289 and total enrolment in higher education rose 31.5% to 4.50 crore.
examFacts: AISHE = All India Survey on Higher Education
Gender Parity Index in higher education: 1.08

items.headline: Vice President launches Mission Rangeen Machhli 2031 in Lakshadweep
items.detail: Vice President C.P. Radhakrishnan released an ornamental fisheries plan called Mission Rangeen Machhli 2031 at Agatti in Lakshadweep.
examFacts: Mission Rangeen Machhli relates to ornamental fisheries

items.headline: Turkiye becomes 71st signatory of Artemis Accords
items.detail: Turkiye signed the Artemis Accords at NASA in Washington DC, becoming the 71st country to join the space exploration framework.

items.headline: IPPB marks 9th Foundation Day with new digital products
items.detail: India Post Payments Bank celebrated its 9th Foundation Day and launched the DakPay Sound Box and digital insurance and mutual fund platforms. It has 13.25 crore customers.

items.headline: Suman Ray appointed Executive Director of RBI
items.detail: The Reserve Bank of India appointed Suman Ray as Executive Director. She will look after DICGC and the Premises Department.
examFacts: Suman Ray: new RBI Executive Director

items.headline: No MDR on UPI payments up to Rs 2,000 and RuPay debit cards
items.detail: The Finance Ministry notified that no merchant discount rate (MDR) can be charged on UPI transactions up to Rs 2,000 and on RuPay debit cards. It is based on Section 10A of the Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007.
examFacts: Legal basis: Section 10A, Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007

items.headline: Ladakh LG V.K. Saxena gets additional charge of J&K
items.detail: Ladakh Lieutenant Governor Vinai Kumar Saxena was given additional charge as Lieutenant Governor of Jammu and Kashmir while Manoj Sinha was on a US visit.
examFacts: V.K. Saxena: Lt Governor of Ladakh

items.headline: Uttarakhand launches free coaching scheme for competitive exams
items.detail: Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami announced the Mukhyamantri Yuva Bhavishya Nirman Yojana for free online coaching for exams like UPSC, SSC, Railways and Banking. Phase 1 covers 11,000 students.
examFacts: Scheme: Mukhyamantri Yuva Bhavishya Nirman Yojana (Uttarakhand)

items.headline: New lichen species Buellia maharajensis found in Kerala
items.detail: A new lichen species, Buellia maharajensis, was found in Mathikettan Shola National Park, Kerala. It is named after Maharaja's College's 150th anniversary.
examFacts: Found in Mathikettan Shola National Park, Kerala

items.headline: Zverev and Rybakina win US Open 2026 singles titles
items.detail: Alexander Zverev of Germany beat Ben Shelton to win the US Open men's title, his second Grand Slam after the 2026 French Open. Elena Rybakina of Kazakhstan beat Aryna Sabalenka for her third Grand Slam and became World No. 1.

items.headline: Dhiraj Bommadevara wins Archery World Cup Final in Mexico
items.detail: Dhiraj Bommadevara became the first Indian male recurve archer to win the individual title at the Archery World Cup Final in Saltillo, Mexico. He beat Japan's Junya Nakanishi 6-5 in a shoot-off.
examFacts: First Indian man to win recurve World Cup Final
Only earlier Indian winner: Dola Banerjee (2007)

items.headline: India and Vietnam to mark 2027 as Year of Friendship
items.detail: At the 19th Joint Commission Meeting in New Delhi, India and Vietnam agreed to mark 2027 as the 'Year of India-Vietnam Friendship' for 55 years of diplomatic ties. They set a trade target of USD 25 billion by 2030.
examFacts: India-Vietnam trade target: USD 25 billion by 2030

items.headline: DRDO to set up third missile testing range at Junput, West Bengal
items.detail: West Bengal approved a DRDO missile testing range at Junput in Purba Medinipur, about 70 km from Chandipur. It will be DRDO's third major testing hub.
examFacts: New DRDO missile range: Junput, Purba Medinipur (West Bengal)

items.headline: Moody's and S&P raise India's FY27 growth forecast to 7%
items.detail: Moody's raised India's FY27 GDP growth forecast to 7% from 6%, and S&P Global raised it to 7.0% from 6.6%. India's GDP grew 7.8% in Q1 of FY27.

items.headline: Marathi film Gondhal is India's official entry for Oscars 2027
items.detail: The Marathi film 'Gondhal', directed by Santosh Davakhar, was chosen as India's entry for Best International Feature Film at the 99th Academy Awards. It is the fourth Marathi film sent as India's entry.

items.headline: HAL hands over Tejas trainers, HTT-40 and Dhruv NG helicopters
items.detail: HAL handed over 2 LCA Tejas twin-seat trainers, 3 HTT-40 basic trainers and 4 Dhruv NG helicopters in Bengaluru. Dhruv NG is India's first indigenous civil helicopter meeting AS-4 standards.

items.headline: India tops Global Business Climate Survey 2026
items.detail: India ranked first among 41 markets in the Global Business Climate Survey 2026 by Business Sweden. Ireland was second and Vietnam third.

items.headline: England pacer Mark Wood retires from international cricket
items.detail: England fast bowler Mark Wood, 36, retired from international cricket. He won the 2019 ODI World Cup and 2022 T20 World Cup with England.

items.headline: Tung Chee-hwa, Hong Kong's first post-colonial leader, dies
items.detail: Tung Chee-hwa, who led Hong Kong from 1997 to 2005 after the handover from Britain, died at 89.
examFacts: Tung Chee-hwa: first Chief Executive of Hong Kong (1997-2005)

items.headline: National Nutrition Week observed from September 1 to 7
items.detail: National Nutrition Week was observed from September 1 to 7, led by the Ministry of Women and Child Development. India has celebrated it since 1982.

items.headline: India finishes 4th at Pickleball World Cup 2026 in Vietnam
items.detail: India won 41 medals (7 gold, 17 silver, 17 bronze) and finished fourth at the Pickleball World Cup held in Da Nang, Vietnam, from August 30 to September 6. Vietnam topped the table.
examFacts: Pickleball World Cup 2026 venue: Da Nang, Vietnam

items.headline: International Day of Clean Air for Blue Skies observed
items.detail: The day was observed on September 7 with the 2026 theme 'Clean Air for Climate Action'. India marks it as Swachh Vayu Diwas.
examFacts: Theme 2026: Clean Air for Climate Action

items.headline: 7th Global Fintech Fest held in Mumbai; NPCI launches FiMI
items.detail: The 7th Global Fintech Fest was held from September 8 to 11 at Jio World Centre, Mumbai. NPCI launched a sovereign AI model called Finance Model for India (FiMI).
examFacts: GFF 2026 was the 7th edition, in Mumbai
NPCI launched FiMI, a sovereign AI model

items.headline: India-Japan air exercise Veer Guardian-2026 held in Jodhpur
items.detail: The Indian Air Force and Japan Air Self-Defense Force held exercise Veer Guardian-2026 at Jodhpur, Rajasthan, from September 9 to 22. IAF fielded Tejas, Su-30 MKI and Rafale jets.

items.headline: Colombo Security Conclave exercise held at Visakhapatnam
items.detail: A Colombo Security Conclave exercise was held from September 9 to 13 at the Eastern Naval Command in Visakhapatnam. Members are India, Sri Lanka, Maldives, Mauritius, Bangladesh and Seychelles.

items.headline: Princess Astrid of Norway dies at 94
items.detail: Princess Astrid of Norway died in Oslo on September 11, 2026, at the age of 94.
examFacts: Princess Astrid of Norway died at 94

items.headline: India hosts 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi
items.detail: The 18th BRICS Summit was held in New Delhi on September 12-13, 2026, with the theme 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability'. Leaders adopted the New Delhi Declaration.
examFacts: 18th BRICS Summit host: New Delhi (India's 2026 chairship)

items.headline: India win both men's and women's AHF Junior Asia Cup hockey titles
items.detail: At the Junior Asia Cup in Inner Mongolia, China, India's men beat South Korea 4-1 for a record sixth title. India's women beat China 1-0 to win a third straight title.
examFacts: Men's Junior Asia Cup: India beat South Korea 4-1 (6th title)

items.headline: Hindi Diwas observed on September 14
items.detail: Hindi Diwas marks the adoption of Hindi in Devanagari script as an official language on September 14, 1949. Amit Shah addressed the 6th All India Official Language Conference in Mumbai.
examFacts: Hindi adopted as official language: 14 Sept 1949

items.headline: National Engineers' Day honours M. Visvesvaraya
items.detail: Engineers' Day on September 15 marks the birth anniversary of Bharat Ratna Mokshagundam Visvesvaraya.

items.headline: India hosts World Circular Economy Forum in Gandhinagar
items.detail: The World Circular Economy Forum 2026 was held in Gandhinagar, Gujarat, from September 15 to 18. India became the first South Asian country to host it.
examFacts: First South Asian host of WCEF

items.headline: Jaishankar visits Bhutan; Rs 4,000 crore credit for energy
items.detail: External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar visited Bhutan from September 16 to 18. India extended a Rs 4,000 crore line of credit for energy projects.
examFacts: India's line of credit to Bhutan: Rs 4,000 crore

items.headline: 13th India-Sri Lanka naval exercise SLINEX held at Visakhapatnam
items.detail: The 13th edition of SLINEX was held at Visakhapatnam from September 17 to 21. INS Kavaratti and INS Jyoti took part from India.

items.headline: Digital Communications Commission dissolved after 37 years
items.detail: The Digital Communications Commission, formed in April 1989 as the Telecom Commission, was dissolved with effect from September 21, 2026.

quiz.q: What is the new base year adopted by MoSPI for National Accounts Statistics released in September 2026?
quiz.solution: MoSPI adopted 2022-23 as the new base year for National Accounts.

quiz.q: Which country became the 71st signatory of the Artemis Accords in September 2026?
quiz.solution: Turkiye signed the Artemis Accords at NASA as the 71st country.

quiz.q: India-Japan exercise 'Veer Guardian-2026' was held at which place?
quiz.solution: Veer Guardian-2026 was held at Jodhpur, Rajasthan, from September 9 to 22.

quiz.q: Who won the men's singles title at US Open 2026?
quiz.solution: Alexander Zverev beat Ben Shelton to win the US Open 2026.

quiz.q: Which Indian archer won the individual recurve title at the 2026 Archery World Cup Final?
quiz.solution: Dhiraj Bommadevara became the first Indian man to win the recurve World Cup Final.

quiz.q: India's men's team beat which country in the final of the 2026 Junior Asia Cup hockey?
quiz.solution: India beat South Korea 4-1 for a record sixth men's Junior Asia Cup title.

quiz.q: Which film was selected as India's official entry for the Oscars 2027?
quiz.solution: The Marathi film Gondhal, directed by Santosh Davakhar, is India's Oscar 2027 entry.

quiz.q: Where will DRDO set up its third major missile testing range?
quiz.solution: West Bengal approved a DRDO range at Junput in Purba Medinipur.

quiz.q: Which city hosted the World Circular Economy Forum 2026?
quiz.solution: WCEF 2026 was held at Mahatma Mandir, Gandhinagar, from September 15 to 18.

quiz.q: The 18th BRICS Summit in September 2026 was held in which city?
quiz.solution: India hosted the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi on September 12-13, 2026.
